clips.send: A transversal is a line crossing two lines at distinct points. If the two lines are parallel, corresponding angles and alternate interior angles are equal. Same-side interior angles add up to one hundred eighty degrees. Each rule works in reverse as a test for parallel lines.

clips.send: A parallelogram’s diagonals bisect each other. Equal diagonals tell you the parallelogram is a rectangle. Perpendicular diagonals tell you it is a rhombus. In a rhombus, each diagonal also splits the interior angles at its endpoints in half. A square has all of these properties.

clips.send: Join the midpoints of two sides of a triangle. The resulting segment is parallel to the third side and half as long.

clips.send: 平行四边形的对角线互相平分。对角线相等的平行四边形是矩形。对角线互相垂直的平行四边形是菱形。在菱形中，每条对角线还平分其两个端点处的内角。正方形具有以上所有性质。

clips.send: 截线与两条直线相交，交点不同。两直线平行，同位角相等，内错角相等，同旁内角互补。反过来，只要有一对同位角相等、一对内错角相等，或一对同旁内角互补，就能判定两直线平行。
